tools.name: search_emoji
tools.description: Find emoji by meaning, mood, slang or name, e.g. "happy", "dead", "fire", "thank you", "flag japan". Returns the emoji characters, names and links, best match first.

tools.name: get_emoji
tools.description: Look up one emoji by the character itself (e.g. "🫠") or its EmojiDig slug (e.g. "melting-face"): name, codepoints, category, Unicode version, aliases, keywords, skin-tone support and related emoji.
